default.description: Capabilities for the ADE window. Nothing here can execute: the agents go through pty_spawn, which keeps its own allowlist, and git goes through git_run, which validates its subcommand. The shell plugin's execute and spawn permissions used to be listed with "args": true for eight binaries — a grant of arbitrary execution to anything running in this window, including a page loaded in the browser pane — and nothing in ADE was using them.
